rule_text: source record ID is unique within its source (later copies flagged)
application time exists and lies between the posting opening and the run cut-off
at least one usable identifier (email or phone) - otherwise the person cannot be de-duplicated
email, when given, is a real address (placeholders like 'na' count as missing)
phone, when given, is a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number
identifier is not a placeholder or a value shared by many different people
referral: candidate phone is not the referrer's own phone
a name is present (WhatsApp/email often have none; matching then relies on identifiers alone)
Date Logged can be read as a date
Date Logged is not day/month ambiguous (read day-first, the sheet's convention)
Screened On is not earlier than Date Logged
a row whose status says it was screened has a Screened On date
Status is a known label with an agreed meaning
Ref is not duplicated (the auto-import sometimes pastes a row twice)
the row can be linked to an application in a source system
